full_judgment: 17. From the evidence of the Informant we also find that there are dwelling houses on all sides of the place of occurrence but no owner of those dwelling houses was examined in this case. Non-examination of close neighbors of the place of occurrence especially the disinterested witnesses calls for a presumption under Section 114(g) of the Evidence Act adverse to the prosecution that had they been examined, they might have deposed against the prosecution case.
